description: Split a PDF into parts that each stay under a target file size — pages are added and the real byte size is measured.

faqs.a: Pages are added one by one and each part is actually saved and measured, so the size limit is enforced on real bytes — not estimates.
faqs.q: How is the size limit enforced?

faqs.a: Yes — a page can never be cut in half, so an oversized single page becomes its own part and is flagged.
faqs.q: What if one page alone is bigger than the limit?

faqs.a: No — splitting happens entirely in your browser.

howto: Set the maximum size per part in MB.
Click "Split" — parts are built and measured for real.
Download all parts as a ZIP, or individually.
title: PDF Split by Size
